svg.text: Flywheel next — the deliverable flow: a session writes a deliverable under the producer and schema in force, the machinery carries it into a store, and the store feeds the next work order

sessions by type on the left · deliverables with their producer, schema and review surface in the middle (190) · the stores the machinery carries them into on the right (203) · solid arrows write · dotted arrows feed (89, 187, 211, 212)
SESSIONS · by type
DELIVERABLES · name · producer skill · schema · review surface (190)
STORES · where the machinery carries a deliverable (203)

research, writing, a throwaway prototype (25)
exits done; the machinery finishes it

exploration, interactive page, running prototype (25)

with-operator · explore over intents

planning

curation · capture reading
charged by the machinery (110, 115, 171)

src/**/*.md · claim blocks in chapters · flywheel/claims.json

context-map/target.yaml · current.yaml · flywheel/map/*.json

openspec/changes/<intent>/ · records · archived at close

the state store
objects/… · proposal + unit documents · offer records
the tracker or the flywheel-state repository; the machinery's alone (203)

flywheel/ledger/<repo>.rec · openspec/specs · acceptance.yaml

inside the chapter (23)

record_offers: one record pointing at the document (62)
wherever its producer says; unstated which store, unstated who is fed
THE NEXT WORK ORDER · prepare_place renders the closed inputs into the place at the books commit named in the header; handed in, never read back (67, 89, 190)

schema instruction · type skill (88)

from the book (97, 189)
the cited chapters and their claim blocks → construction
the covered intents' chapters and claims → explore / gathered
claims.json → curation, planning

the elements the item builds, their homes,
the claims attached there → construction
the surface specification in force when a cited

the records of earlier elaborations → the next
elaboration on the intent

the unit document → its stages
the open bolts with their units and states → planning
unconsumed asks, redo notes → planning
unmoved signals, open intents → curation
from the ledger and the line (28, 102)
the backlog derived from the cells → planning
the as-built statements → planning, review
the place at the line's head → every session
the unit's change → later stages

design session writes
construction session writes
machinery-charged session writes
the machinery carries it into a store (an effect with a proof)
a store feeds the next work order
